preparatory_statement: This is an unpopulated fail-closed receipt template. It contains no provider, consumer, hosted, VPS, E2E, or production runtime evidence.

classification_vocabulary.proven: The exact required receipt and independent verification prove the criterion at its claimed evidence class.
classification_vocabulary.not_proven: The implementation or a narrative may exist, but the required exact proof is absent, stale, mismatched, or not independently verified.
classification_vocabulary.partial: Some bounded subcriteria are proven, while one or more mandatory subcriteria remain unresolved.
classification_vocabulary.blocked_external: The criterion cannot be completed by LiNKskills because a named external owner or environment has not supplied its required receipt or approval.
classification_vocabulary.excluded: The criterion is explicitly outside the approved scope; it must cite the authoritative exclusion and cannot be used to imply completion.
classification_vocabulary.not_assessed: Preparation-only value; forbidden in a final reconciliation decision.

ledger.basis: PREPARATORY_ONLY: exact qualification evidence is absent.

ledger.basis: OpenClaw, Platform, hosted, and independent receipts are external and absent.

ledger.basis: This preparatory template is not the final independent reconciliation.

rollback_recovery.immutable_release_rule: Rollback restores a previously qualified exact release or prior consumer pin; it never rewrites an immutable release.

required_before_final_decision: PKT-25 exact pushed source commit/tree, scoped diff, commands, tests, receipt digest, rollback, and handoff
XPKT-04 provider, Platform, Autowork, OpenClaw, stage, VPS, and production receipts with exact identities
XPKT-05 independent inspection receipt proving each supplied receipt was inspected rather than copied
Founder approval records for reserved schema, migration, protocol, publication, activation, and production actions
Correction packets naming the original owner for every partial, not-proven, or blocked criterion
handoff_must_not_claim: runtime health from source or local tests
stage, VPS, E2E, or production from a lower evidence class
qualification, selectability, activation, or permission from file presence
completion while any required dependency or evidence class remains unresolved

deterministic_decision_rules: Reject the receipt if any required dependency receipt is absent, malformed, stale, or identity-mismatched.
Reject a criterion marked proven unless every required evidence class has an exact receipt and XPKT-05 independently verified it.
Mark partial only when the ledger names the proven subcriteria and the unresolved mandatory subcriteria.
Mark blocked_external only when the missing action is owned outside LiNKskills and the named owner and handoff are recorded.
A lower evidence class never satisfies a higher class; source, consumer, hosted/stage, VPS, E2E, and production remain separate.

The final decision is COMPLETE only when every mandatory criterion is proven or an authoritative exclusion is recorded and no contradiction, unresolved dependency, or rollback gap remains; otherwise HOLD.
